title: Winter AQI is 2.3× the monsoon level
text: Across 2020–2026 (days with ≥3 stations reporting), the city-wide daily AQI averages 132 in Nov–Feb versus 58 in Jun–Sep — 2.3× higher. December is the worst month on average (146); July the cleanest (56).

title: Year-by-year: best and worst years
text: Among years with at least 3 stations meeting the coverage bar, 2025 had the highest typical station-average AQI (104) and 2021 the lowest (81).
caveat: The set of stations differs between years, and 2024–25 AQI is computed from concentrations (see Methodology), so treat year-to-year changes as indicative.

title: The most and least polluted areas
text: Over their full records, Revenue Colony–Shivajinagar has the highest average daily AQI (136) and Panchawati–Pashan the lowest (77) among stations with at least 438 valid days.
caveat: Stations cover different periods; compare same-year values in the region table for a fair comparison.

title: A consistent hotspot
text: Revenue Colony–Shivajinagar was the most polluted station in 3 of 3 years (comparing only stations with valid data in the same year).

title: The 2020 lockdown effect
text: Only one station (Karve Road) has data for both periods: its average AQI in Apr–May 2020 was 29% lower than in Apr–May 2019.
caveat: Based on a single station, so this is an indication rather than a city-wide measurement.

title: Diwali spikes
text: Across the 4 Diwalis (of 9) with enough data, city-wide AQI over the Diwali days (day before Lakshmi Puja to 2 days after) averaged 72% above the same city level two to three weeks earlier.
caveat: Part of this rise is seasonal (post-monsoon air gets worse through Oct–Nov anyway).

title: Time of day matters
text: In winter, the average hourly AQI across stations peaks around 09:00 (176) and is lowest around 17:00 (104). If you exercise outdoors in winter, the afternoon is typically the cleaner window.

title: Weekends vs weekdays
text: City-wide average AQI is 97 on weekdays and 95 on weekends (-1.9%).

title: What drives Pune's AQI (2024–2026)
text: The pollutant setting the hourly AQI was PM10 56%, PM2.5 17%, CO 17% of the time across all stations. Particulate matter (PM10 + PM2.5) was the deciding pollutant 73% of the time.
caveat: Individual pollutants are only available from 2024 onward. CO and O₃ sub-indices here use hourly values against 8-hour breakpoints, which can overstate their role relative to the official daily AQI.

title: How often is the air acceptable?
text: On 58% of the 1900 days with a city-wide value, Pune's median AQI was Good or Satisfactory (≤100); on 2% it was Poor or worse (>200).
